package.description: Chromium browser compiled with the Clang/LLVM compiler.

en-US.description: Chromium browser compiled with the Clang/LLVM compiler.
en-US.longDescription:
The Chromium web browser for Windows and Linux built with the open source Clang compiler and LLD
linker.

Additional features of the builds include modified compiler and linker optimizations via build
configuration modifications.

Implementation of various options are subject to change depending upon performance, stability, and
similar paramaters.
en-US.name: Chromium Installer
